reason: Owner directive 2026-11-03 (ADR0023) makes native ship-loop the single delivery authority; remove the inherited PR-gate caller rather than overriding it.

edits.before: No PR, no babysit, no `architect` unless the investigation precedes a code change. If it does, hand back to the user and re-route to Bug fix or Feature.
edits.after: An investigation produces a cited answer, not a delivery run. If a code change is also authorized, continue under Bug fix or Feature and use the installed [ship-loop](../../ship-loop/SKILL.md) skill for delivery.
